newsitem.title: USA: Photoelectron raises $2.2 mln with offering.
newsitem.headline: Photoelectron raises $2.2 mln with offering.

text.p: Photoelectron Corp said Wednesday that the managing underwriters have exercised the "Green Shoe" option to purchase an additional 275,000 shares of its common stock based on the company's initial public offering price of $8.50 per share.
A green shoe option is a clause in an underwriting agreement that allows additional shares to be sold when demand is strong.
The company estimates that it will receive net proceeds of $2,173,875, which have been tentatively been allocated for general corporate purposes.
The added stock will increase the number of outstanding shares to 6,795,104. Needham & Company and Dain Bosworth Inc were underwriters for Photoelectron's IPO on January 29.

Photoelectron Corp is engaged in the design, development and commercialization of the Photon Radiosurgery System, a proprietary device for the treatment of cancerous tumors through the application of x-ray radiation.
